title: Give Forms App an Owned Tool Job Factory
description: Fix the forms editor runtime dispatch defect by adding an app-owned ArtifactOwnedToolJobFactory covering every forms tool, honest publication contracts derived from each command handler, Artifact/Config lane ArtifactStoreOneItemPreparationFactory implementations where required, factory_type wiring in bounded proofs, registry overrides, and an exact-and-exhaustive retained route disposition test. Verify the baseline missing-owned-reducer behavior, forms library tests, wasm32-wasip2 check, regenerated forms descriptor, and plugin registry check.
